title: NILS request headers
description: Wave 4c sections 5.5 and 6.3: the three headers a caller may set on an engine door, and the actor object the engine records.

ceiling.description: X-Nils-Ceiling: a downgrade only cap named as a ladder step (grants.schema.json); the caller keeps the grants the step's set holds and assistant:use, detail is lowered to the step's, admin keeps everything, and the ceiling is recorded on what the call touches

actor.description: X-Nils-Actor as JSON, and what the engine stores on audit rows, handles and decisions. An absent header is recorded as {"kind": "absent"}. A token whose act claim (RFC 8693) names an actor binds it: the header may say agent or model and never person, and cannot name another actor than act.sub, nor another model than act.model, the registered model the issuer bound to the actor; an agent's token without act.model cannot act as a model. Record 42 S1 and R6.

name.description: The station or agent, such as ask-help; under a token with an act claim, act.sub and nothing else

model.description: The registered model acting, by id, digest or name@version; under a token with an act claim, the act.model the issuer bound, written as the token writes it

ceiling.description: The ceiling in force when the engine recorded the actor

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key on run, jobs, apply and promote: per principal, kept for a day; a repeat is answered again and says so, a changed body is refused
